items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: Maynard wanted me, when I was 13 he asked my dad and my dad was making mouthpieces for him.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. So earlier today I looked up the word “obsession” in the dictionary. Obsession: an idea or thought that continually preoccupies or intrudes on a person’s mind. So my question is are you and have you been obsessed with music all your life?

The reverse, actually the reverse. Music was a hobby for me when I was a kid. I loved my boat, my parents were the opposite of stage parents. I had a lot of opportunity — Maynard wanted me, when I was 13 he asked my dad and my dad was making mouthpieces for him. He wanted to take me on the road as his protégé because he heard the “Ted Mack Show.” So my dad politely said no, I want him to have a regular childhood. And they did. And I did. Girls, my boat, music I did gigs just to buy gasoline for my boat as a…
